mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals a broad-based expansion in manufacturing activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when INDPRO exceeds 12-month MA compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate recession risks.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% compared to baseline.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when RSAFS exceeds 12-month MA compared to baseline.
